environment.description: Same application deployed on EC2 in a private subnet. Traffic routes through an internal NLB. The VPC has an S3 gateway endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with a restrictive endpoint policy that includes a condition requiring aws:ResourceTag/write-lock to equal 'unlocked' for s3:PutObject actions on the promotional-assets-internal bucket. The S3 bucket objects under the 'redemptions/' prefix are tagged with write-lock=locked via an S3 Object Lambda that applies tags on creation. Additionally, the endpoint policy includes a StringEquals condition on s3:prefix limiting PutObject to paths matching a request-id header hash, and the NLB target group has a deregistration delay of 0 with connection draining disabled, combined with a Lambda@Edge-equivalent authorizer on the NLB that serializes requests per token using a DynamoDB conditional write (attribute_not_exists(tokenId)) before forwarding. The VPC endpoint policy specifically denies s3:PutObject when aws:CalledVia does not include the serialization layer ARN.

config.network: Internal NLB with pre-request DynamoDB conditional write authorizer (attribute_not_exists on token partition key)
config.dynamodb_lock_table: promo-token-locks with partition key 'tokenId', conditional write attribute_not_exists(tokenId) enforced by NLB authorizer Lambda before request reaches application
config.iam_role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/promo-service-gated-role with permission boundary requiring aws:RequestTag/serialization-token on PutObject
